title: Gameland
tagline: Gameland is a  blockchain game rental platform, building open scholarship community
description: Gameland platform is a rental platform, which is designed to help game users experience high-end games at the lowest price, integrate the benefits of Defi, provide users experience to earn , open up the boundaries between players and games, and feed back the area blockchain games in multiple dimensions, bring new upgrades to blockchain games.
how_its_made: This project uses React and Typescript to build Client Framework, and uses Ethereum development environment - Solidity + Hardhat to build frontend. The web Client Library uses Web3.js&Truffle/Ether.js&Waffle.  In the Next, we will use NFT.Storage, the storage api of NFT.Storage to provide us with simple development technology for establishing data storage
